description: Delete a segment from a trip. This action cannot be undone. For commercial cruise reservations and sea/port days use cruise_* tools. Never substitute Activity, CruiseActivity or another segment type for a cruise day. Ordinary shore excursions remain valid Activity/CruiseActivity. If cruise tools are unavailable explain the limitation and ask for clarification. Cruise/CruiseDay generic writes require the dedicated cruise tools; their schemas and full reads remain available.

segment_id.description: The ID of the segment to delete
